Ease of Use

Value for Money 
The Litesizer series is the perfect choice to characterize nano- and microparticles at the touch of a button. Particles in dispersion as well as peptides or macromolecules in solution can be determined over a broad concentration range, limiting the time for sample preparation. Litesizer 500 includes three measurement angles for particle size determination as well as patented cmPALS technology, which enables zeta potential measurements at low voltages with the highest repeatability and accuracy.
Particle characterization from the nano- to the micrometer range
Particle size measurements via dynamic light scattering at three different measurement angles
Determination of zeta potential using patented cmPALS
Molecular mass and refractive index measurements
Application eBookCannabis Testing 
Ensuring the safety and consistency of cannabis and CBD-containing products
Cannabis and CBD-containing products are a rapidly growing market, yet they have an unclear and still developing regulatory environment. Ensuring the safety and consistency of new cannabis and CBD-containing products start with high-quality, reproducible, and accurate scientific measurements.
This expert guide highlights a range of cannabis product testing and production workflows that Anton Paar actively supports through its premier instruments, and the knowledge and insight gained from decades of experience working in testing, R&D, production, and QC labs.
This eBook will also outline:
CBD emulsion
The shelf life of cannabis
The science behind quality CBD-containing products
23 Mar 2023
VideoMaterials 
Characterizing Nano- and Microparticles in Dispersions and Solutions using the Litesizer™ 500 Particle Analyzer
Watch this video to see how easy it is to conduct particle analysis using the Litesizer™ 500 from Anton Paar. The Litesizer™ analyzes nano- and microparticles by measuring dynamic, electrophoretic and static light scattering. You can set up your experiments in just a few seconds, and create the analyses and reports you need at the single touch of a button. The software is so simple and intuitive that even kids can handle it.
